name: Release: v2.1.2
body:
## Changes Since v2.1.1

- Workflow changes (tag/build only when changing program and not scripts/docs/etc.) (dc61f1b)
- Updated to newer task version, ignores pre-release versions when getting tags (if used), improvement in variables (81eeb7d)
- Few minor updates to scripts (ae04ec1)
- Change default score host and port to match the current AeroJudge standard (ba87ca4)
- Updated device_reset to use the newer curl for the latest fetch_update script, this process was also resetting the settings.json file to an older default, so I added a sed line to correct it to the AeroJudge config of 192.168.8.100 / port 80 (14720c0)

[Full Changelog](https://github.com/IMAC-ORG/imac-judge-app/compare/v2.1.1...v2.1.2)

name: Release: v2.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Version 2.0: Major updates for 2026 season by @dpgarceau and @DevDavidW in https://github.com/IMAC-ORG/imac-judge-app/pull/107

### Core Features
- Per-type round numbering (KNOWN, UNKNOWN, FREESTYLE independent counters)
- Incomplete KNOWN round detection and warning
- FREESTYLE support with full scoring functionality
- Sequence validation with warnings shown and graceful fallbacks
- Score mismatch resolution tools for scorekeepers
- Retrieve unknown figures package from Score (4.71 or greater)

### Admin Pages Redesign
- /admin/comp - Competition settings management
- /admin/device - Device/system management with update capability
- /admin/scores - Score management tools

### UI Improvements
- Admin confirmation modal before accessing admin pages
- Battery indicator improvements (warnings only)
- Improved pilot selection and judging page layouts
- Disabled buttons for unavailable sequence types
- Improved error handling

### Technical
- Configurable timeouts and settings API
- Updated audio files including freestyle caller and new user help

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/IMAC-ORG/imac-judge-app/compare/v1.2...v2.0

name: Release: v1.2
body:
## What's Changed

by @DevDavidW in https://github.com/IMAC-ORG/imac-judge-app/pull/91

- Added an info display to show app version number, IP address, WiFi connection details, battery voltage, and Score availability status
- Updated Create Tag workflow to use dynamic tag name based on version number sequence
- Updated the pom to allow multiple projects (this was when I had the new service which I moved back away from) so now can run the clean and package from the root folder

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/IMAC-ORG/imac-judge-app/compare/v1.0.119...v1.2

name: Release: v1.1.2

## What's Changed
by @DevDavidW in https://github.com/IMAC-ORG/imac-judge-app/pull/90
* Allow pilot primary and secondary IDs to contain characters from Score
* Changed pilot index to be int (allows to be used in field id's for carousel)
* Fix std/alt override (was broken)
* Unknown judging can use the direction B/C flip (useful for NATS where unknown sequences are loaded)

by @DevDavidW in https://github.com/IMAC-ORG/imac-judge-app/pull/88
* Fix filter to reapply when returning to Home (after pilot select and judging started)
* Added pilot's name to top of pilot select/judge dialog
* Reorganize pilot select/judge dialog to be more user friendly
* Show message when no pilots loaded (fixed blank screen)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/IMAC-ORG/imac-judge-app/compare/v1.0.118...v1.1.2
